product_from_film: Saffron assesses engineering candidates using real repositories and AI tools, recording code changes and prompts for an evaluation report.
explains_well: The film clearly contrasts conventional interview exercises with work on a real codebase using AI, then outlines repository selection, work and analysis.
unclear: No specific candidate action is connected to a report finding, so the meaning of the scores and AI-reliance percentage remains vague.
scenario: AI coding and interview clips establish a hiring mismatch; founders explain real-codebase assessments and show illustrative tracking/report overlays.
product_clear_basis: Real Codebase Real Tools appears at 31s after the hiring comparison; the draft already states candidate AI-use assessment at 13s.

sound.detail: The draft supports real-codebase assessments, repository selection, work trials, tracking edits/prompts and analyzing AI use. Several names and phrases are malformed, so visible Saffron labels supply the name and no exact opening percentage is treated as established fact. No validated listening, music, effects or delivery assessment.

categories.finding: Silent viewing communicates real-codebase hiring and report metrics, but the meaning of individual scores is unresolved.
Large comparison text makes the central difference clear; translucent report elements compete with the presenter.
A 12s problem opening is followed by roughly 24s of team/positioning, then about 15s of setup and report before closing.
The old hiring exercise resolves into a proposed real-work assessment, but no candidate decision or hiring outcome is demonstrated.
Founders and real-work wording may suggest practical familiarity; actual employer trust is unmeasured.
The repository→work→analysis sequence is clear at a high level, but the link between captured behavior and evaluation is missing.
Hiring 10x engineers, assessment validity and AI-use interpretation are film claims. No prediction quality or candidate outcomes were verified.
Explicit support for candidates using AI on a real codebase gives the assessment proposition a clear identity.
Connect one recorded action to one report finding.
